==Biography==

== Trivia ==
* Is the younger brother of [[Hyper (Gaj Lipovšek)|Hyper]].
* Often shows off his exaggerated love for his OnePlus phone due to the brand sponsoring [[FNATIC]].
* Is known for showing very little emotions.
* Good friends with [[LS]], they often do content together such as co-streams or coaching.
** In early 2021 Nemesis went to Korea to do content with him.
* Won both [[European Masters/2018 Season/Summer/Main Event|European Masters in 2018]] (with [[MAD Lions E.C.]]) and then 7 years later [[EMEA Masters/2025 Season/Winter|EMEA Masters in 2025]] (with [[Los Ratones]]) together with [[Crownie]].
=== Individual Awards ===
* LEC 2nd All-Pro Team (Spring 2020)
* LEC 3rd All-Pro Team (Summer 2019)
* EMEA Masters Finals MVP (Spring 2025)
* 2x NLC 1st All-Pro Team (Spring 2025, Summer 2025)
